judged_text: The `automatic` guard in group_member.hbs resolves against the member item context (a Discourse.User), not the group, and User has no `automatic` property. The remove ('x') link renders on every member row even when viewing an automatic group; clicking it issues DELETE /admin/groups/:id/members which the server rejects with 422, so the admin gets an unexplained error on a control that should never have been shown.

adjudication.rationale: In `admin/templates/group_member.hbs` the guard is `{{#unless automatic}} ... {{/unless}}`, but this template is rendered as an `itemView` inside `{{each member in members itemView="group-member"}}` (`admin/templates/group.hbs`). That means the template’s context is the per-member item (a `Discourse.User`), not the group/controller, and `Discourse.User` does not have an `automatic` property in this diff. An undefined `automatic` is falsy, so `unless automatic` will evaluate true and the remove link will render even for automatic groups. Clicking it triggers `removeMember` which calls `DELETE /admin/groups/:id/members.json` (`Discourse.Group#removeMember`), and the server explicitly rejects modifications to automatic groups with 422 (`Admin::GroupsController#remove_member` calls `can_not_modify_automatic`).
